title: Introduction of Map of the Month

posts.h:
Celebrating the best maps once again!



Hello, Brick Soldiers and Brick Builders. Kagome here to inform you guys that the Map of the Month was announced to celebrate the best and well-made maps once again! Instead of Map of the Week, it is now Map of the Month.

And yes it's been a long time to hear this, but starting today: It is time to grab our trusty and sturdy Brick-Gun and create the most glorious and the best well-made map we can imagine!


"Where and how can we start?" you may wondered.
  • Post your map in the Forum section Map of the Month
  • Your map must be created in the respective month.
  • Add screenshots, amount of bricks and playable modes to your post.
  • You can make your map for any mode.
  • Entry deadline is the last day of the month respectively, instead of the week.
  • The winner will be announced in the following month.
Will there be rewards for winning the Map of the Month?
Yes, there will be rewards for 3 winners for Map of the Month. The 1st place winner will also win the exclusive forum title "Builder of the Month".

1st Place: Weapon of choice, 10,000 Tokens, and exclusive Forum Title “Builder of the Month”
2nd Place: Weapon of choice, 5,000 Tokens
3rd Place: Weapons of choice. 2,500 Tokens

How will my map I submitted will be judged on?
Your map will be judged on 4 things:
  • Balance: Is the map balanced? Does every team have a chance to win?
  • Visuals: Is there a theme, and how was it incorporated into the map?
  • Complexity: How intricate and how much effort was put into making the map?
  • Special features: Is there anything unique that affects and adds to the gameplay?
I hope you have understand the new introduction of the Map of The Month and have a great time creating the most fabulous and well-made map in Brick-Wide World!

We want to see your most beautiful, imaginative, elaborate and most fun maps as well!
